name: RC-B10-0452/2026 – After § 7 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text: 7a. Considers, in addition, that EU sanctions have severely and negatively affected the human rights situation in Iran, particularly public health, access to medicines, including cancer treatments, and food security; calls therefore for the immediate lifting of those EU sanctions on Iran that negatively affect the human rights and living conditions of the Iranian people;
